from.tooltip:
**My reading of your sticky note, and a guess.**

Crowding is a property of the aggregate, not of any one name: when conviction stacks — technicals and insider buying pointing the same way across several Positions — the portfolio can end up on one side of a trade that everyone else is also on.

Your narrow risk number cannot see it: it never sees technicals or insider clusters at all. So if crowding is a risk you care about, nothing currently computes it, and this box is a hole rather than a stage.

Delete it if the note meant something else.
